test_title: PYST 33: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 19 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ensuring**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence discusses the positive outcomes that could have resulted from enlightened policy approaches after the first NFHS was conducted.
 
• The blank requires a word that shows the result or aim of these actions, which is that no child or woman is left behind in health efforts.
 
• "**Ensuring**" is the most appropriate word, as it indicates making certain that all individuals benefit from health initiatives.
 
• Other options like "**suggesting**", "**searching**", and "**avoiding**" do not fit the context of guaranteeing positive outcomes for all.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The National Family Health Survey (NFHS) mentioned in its report how effectively India has used its newly created wealth to alter a dismal record of nutritional deprivation, ill-health and lost potential among__ its citizens, particularly women and children. Given the steady growth in real per capita GDP since the 1980s, and the progress made since Independence in overcoming severe undernourishment, enlightened policy approaches could have brought about a giant leap from 1992-93, when the first NFHS was conducted, __ensuring__ that no child or woman was left behind in the quest for health for all. Evidently, the Indian state has not viewed the situation as constituting a national crisis, even at the height of a prosperous phase of economic growth when a decade ago 39% of children under the age of five remained underweight. It comes as no surprise, therefore, that this failure to assume responsibility for child nutrition has left 34% of children in that age group underweight today. There is also a lot of evidence to show that the __poorest__ sections of India’s children have low weight even at birth due to the general __neglect__ of women’s nutrition and well-being. It is imperative that the coming data lead to the charting of a new policy course that makes __access__ to nutrition and health a right for all.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Suggesting: Means proposing an idea, which does not guarantee a result.
 
• Searching: Means looking for something, which does not fit the context of achieving a result.
 
• Avoiding: Means keeping away from something, not guaranteeing all will benefit.
